practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement.practice: Purpose and frequency map before motion judgment
practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement.how: Classify chrome feedback, focus/navigation, selected-performance content and repeated-visit decoration separately. Use emil-design-eng and review-animations for control polish; use remove-animations to challenge unnecessary repeated chrome without deleting the reason for the study.

For each control record fine/coarse pointer, hover, focus-visible and reduced-motion states. Tag each result as source, programmatic browser, native input, spoken AT, physical device or observed human task. Successful selectOption must not become a keyboard-menu pass.

practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement.practice: Realistic stress cases and comfortable return task
practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement.how: Use break-ui methods for actual longest labels, 320px and 200% text/zoom views through a dev-only data boundary when implementing future mutable UI. Couple them with a phone choose/play/pause/seek/enlarge/revisit task; record assistance and scroll exposure. Do not invent an empty or huge catalogue scenario where the fixed content model does not allow it.

Use Before/After/Why for source findings, attach actual states/screenshots, preserve scores and unresolved limits, and recheck gallery focus handoff, offscreen between-clip cancellation and live reduced-motion change after material interaction edits.

skillsExceptions: The sub-300ms and keyboard no-animation guidance governs interface response; deliberately requested multi-second character acting remains content, including when Play is invoked with a keyboard.
GPU transform/opacity guidance does not authorize deleting expressive SVG details or tiny anatomy. Optimize demonstrated cost rather than assumed cost.
A scrolling local document retains native scrolling, text copying and zoom. App-shell overscroll, safe-area and viewport rules apply only when a future surface creates that need.
Static reduced-motion poses and direct seeking already preserve meaning; no decorative fade is added merely to satisfy generic guidance.
This frozen review adds no fixtures, libraries, prototypes or source edits. The practical future workflow does not create a new permission gate or claim unperformed checks.
